acceptanceCriteria: 旧 Runtime finalization 的 status 与 migrate plan 必须给出历史 recovery 分类和可执行 safe action，且不改写任何历史 bytes。
finalize-verify 对已关闭或待关闭的旧 receipt 必须提供明确的历史 recovery projection 或下一步命令；当前 Runtime 生成的新 receipt 仍严格要求 runtime identity。
shared worktree retained 通过 Runtime-bound recovery 输入完成 verify 与 close；direct merge no PR 使用 number=0、真实 merge commit、parents、base、repository identity 与 historical_low，禁止虚构 PR。
提供只读、Git-fact-derived 的 recovery/receipt scaffold，所有不可推导的 actor、authority、reason 和人类决定保持 unknown 或要求显式输入。
新增 WI-016、WI-018、WI-027 形态的回归测试，覆盖 stale runtime、missing/zero PR number、tamper、foreign identity、stale base、symlink 与历史 bytes immutable。
三语命令与 workflow 文档、发布 adopter acceptance 脚本同步；新 Release 必须通过完整 workspace quality、公开 adopter、N-1 upgrade 与历史 recovery acceptance。
goal: 提供历史 finalization 的可发现 recovery/projection 与 Git 事实驱动的候选输入，保持新 Work Item 的严格当前 Runtime gate，并以对象形态回归和发布后验收证明 WI-016、WI-018、WI-027 可安全收口。
intent: 使已发布 Runtime 能够诚实且可操作地恢复旧版本历史 finalization；对象工程不能因历史 receipt 版本差异或无 PR 本地合并而被迫伪造治理证据。
outOfScope: 对象工程文件及其 .ai 数据
新 Work Item 的当前 finalization policy

scenarioCoverage.expected: A valid already-closed legacy receipt is projected as historical_low or receives a precise recovery action and is never reported as a current Runtime failure.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: legacy closed receipt with stale Runtime identity
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a fixture whose finalization and close receipts were produced by an older Runtime, then execute finalize-verify and read-only status/migrate plan with the current Runtime.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An immutable retained receipt is classified with a Runtime-bound historical recovery record and can reach explicit close without rewriting predecessor bytes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record a recovery binding from repository and predecessor facts, verify it, close with structured human authority, and compare predecessor bytes before and after.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A complete receipt accepts pullRequest.number=0 only with historical.kind=direct_merge_no_pr, real merge commit, at least two parents, base, repository identity, and historical_low assurance; no PR is fabricated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Build a real two-parent Git merge fixture, record the complete receipt through the CLI path, verify against Git, and close with an explicit decision.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing/zero PR number without historical metadata, foreign identity, stale predecessor digest, stale base, malformed JSON, symlink, and forged merge parents fail closed with actionable stable diagnostics.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run negative protocol and repository tests for each mutation and assert that no predecessor or archive bytes are rewritten.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A downloaded immutable Release binary can inspect legacy finalization fixtures, emit a recovery plan, and preserve isolation and cleanup evidence without source fallback.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the release acceptance and upgrade acceptance scripts against the published candidate and assert runtime identity, historical recovery, isolation manifests, and cleanup receipt.
